buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of

CHIEF ENGINEER PROJECT SAMPARK payable at SBI HARI MARKET BRANCH JAMMU . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of CHIEF ENGINEER PROJECT SAMPARK payable at SBI HARI MARKET BRANCH JAMMU . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses THE BIDDER TO ENSURE THE FOLLOWING:- Technical Evaluation Criteria: - The following documents/certificates will be checked during technical evalu ation of the bidders, accordance with the published bid conditions: - (a) EMD: EMD exemption shall be applicable to OEMs registered as MSME under Sub- Class 0 8106 only. Owner/Joint owner of crusher will be considered as OEMs and will be considered for MSME exem ption. EMD of Rs. 4.00 Lakh is required to be submitted by resellers. (b) Bidders listed with BRO: Bidders listed with BRO will be evaluated as per para 1.5 of ATC. Bidders to upload the copy of enlistment letter if exemption for EMD is sought. Bidders banne d by HQ DGBR in the latest WLR will not be considered eligible for the bid. (c) Bidder’s turnover: Documentary evidence of minimum average annual turnover of R s. 115.00 lakh during the last three financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). (d) OEM turnover: OEM average annual turnover (For crusher owner/joint Owner) for last 03 FY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 - Rs. 237.00 Lakh. (e) Past experience: Past experience of at least three year of experience in the same/ similar work for FY 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025–26. Copy of GEM Contract showing Supply and CRAC in eac h FY to be submitted (f) Past performance: Past-performance requirement of Single Contract of 50% of the Bid estimated amount during last 03 FYs (g) Stone crusher: Ownership documents or valid lease/agreement for one stone crusher, al ong with a valid pollution certificate, as applicable.

(h) Tippers: Ownership documents or valid lease agreement for four tippers, in accordance w ith the ATC.The lease documents should not be more than 03 months old from the bid opening date. (j) ATC compliance: The ATC conditions should be accepted on the company letter head. All the pages of the ATC should be duly signed and stamped. (k) Integrity Pact: Duly completed Integrity Pact is to be submitted alongwith the bid. Note:- The bidders to ensure that all the documents submitted are legible and only documents th at have been asked are submitted. . 10.
